notes: Access route: Cloudflare-protected (direct requests get a 403 'Just a moment...' challenge); all pages fetched with curl_cffi impersonate='chrome124' (200 OK on every page used). Category discovery: downloaded all 7 shards of the product sitemap (sitemap-1..7.xml, ~140MB total) and regex-extracted every <loc> ending in '/' under the lighting/, home-furnishings/, furnishings/, bathroom/ and cooking-and-dining/ path prefixes to build the full category tree (396 candidate category URLs), then hand-picked the decor-in-scope ones and verified each live. Count verification: every category page embeds window.tm.categoryId; that id was queried against the site's own internal search backend (https://search-lon.therange.co.uk/api/productlist?categoryId=<id>&limit=1&offset=0), whose JSON response includes an exact 'totalResults' field (not a rounded/capped widget) - this is the site's own authoritative count, distinct from the unreliable in_stock facet sums also present in the same payload. Cross-checked against window.tm.breadcrumb on each page to confirm the categoryId matched the intended category. Roll-up handling (Rule 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad'): where a parent listing's total was well explained by its child subcategories (overlap only, no large uncounted remainder) - All Mirrors (4141), Clocks (981), LED Lighting (1065), Lighting Accessories & Fittings (5838, also mixes in excluded Switches/Dimmers/Sockets) - the parent's own total was DROPPED in favour of listing its child subtypes as leaves. Where children covered under half of the parent total (Glassware: named subtypes summed to 1286 of 2618; Tableware & Dinnerware: 5345 of 11916, with the named children being non-exhaustive facets like 'new-in'/'kids'/'mugs') the PARENT total was kept as a single leaf and the partial children were dropped instead, per Rule 0/scope: 'Tableware/dinnerware' is explicitly in-scope under Kitchen & Dining. Tableware and Dinnerware sample titles show it is overwhelmingly dinner sets/mugs/glasses but a small fraction (~1/15 sampled) were cutlery sets cross-listed in the same category; could not cleanly strip these from the exact count without under/over-counting, so the site's own total was kept as-is (status remains ok given the contamination is minor). Exclusions applied: Light Bulbs (all subtypes), Switches/Dimmers/Sockets (wiring), New in Lighting, Lighting Clearance (sale), Smart Lighting (categoryId 2521502, 92 items - sampled titles show mostly smart bulbs/LED strips/electronic gadgets, a mixed roll-up dropped per Rule 'inspect actual titles'), Party Lighting (categoryId 393477, totalResults=1 - a thin marketing 'Collection' page, not a real category), Decorative Storage, Decorative Tables and Stools, Room Dividers, Andrew Lee Home and Living (brand-listing page), Home Decor Trends (marketing hub/collections), New In Home Furnishing, all Artificial Flowers/Plants/Wreaths/Garlands/Bouquets/Potted-fakes subcategories under Vases & Artificial Plants (faux plants explicitly excluded; only the genuine Vases and Indoor Pots & Planters children were kept), House Plants (real living plants, not decor), all textiles (bedding, cushions/throws, curtains/blinds, rugs/mats), all furniture (coat/hat racks, bean bags, bathroom furniture/cabinets/vanity units), Bathroom fixtures/plumbing/heating/basins/toilets/baths/showers/towels/functional-accessories (bins, scales, pull cords, shower curtains, towel holders) and the entire Bathstore sub-brand (plumbing/suites/taps/radiators), Kitchen Appliances/Cookware, Candles/Home Fragrance/Wax Melts (scented candles - only the explicit 'Unscented Candles' leaf was kept per scope), Table Linen/Placemats/Coasters (textile). The entire Garden department (garden/*) was treated as out of scope and not traversed - the task specifies the Home & Decor department navigation, and The Range's Garden department (furniture, tools, machinery, sheds, greenhouses, seeds/plants) is a large, separate top-level department at this general retailer; the two arguably-decor Garden subcategories (garden-ornaments-and-decoration, gardening/pots-planters-and-flower-beds) were left out for consistency with that department-level boundary rather than cherry-picked in. Duplicate-company determination: 'The Range' (therange.co.uk) is a standalone UK general discount retailer (part of CDS Superstores group) with no other entry in this batch under a different name/URL that this worker is aware of; no duplicate found. Prior worker note: a previous session on this same SR was terminated by a platform outage mid-run; this run is a full fresh restart (its /js/plp chunk files and lighting/mirrors HTML dumps were reused only to locate the window.tm.categoryId mechanism, not as extracted data).
